# History runs (generated by analyze_history.py, history runs from 1443)

Sections 1-4: rates are Wilson 95% intervals; differences are bootstrap 95% intervals over matched scenarios; any cell with fewer than 10 runs is marked 'small sample'. Section 5 pools runs that share scenarios (several history runs and, for the models suite, three models per scenario), so every interval there is a percentile bootstrap 95% that resamples scenarios with all their runs, n is given as runs (scenarios), and 'small sample' marks fewer than 10 scenarios. Every number is computed from run folders and records files.

**What healing did and why (heal-mode records; means per run). dropped by rule: claims dropped per memheal/heal.py rule, summed over the runs whose record states it (heal v2), with each rule's share: name = names the observed destination; source-taint = a root page's pointer or change claim; cf = the claim-level counterfactual; ddmin = delta debugging; support = a rebuilt claim no input supports; oracle = the AttackSpec. ddmin replays per run. Post-heal check: the explained decision replayed on the frozen set as healing left it, when a retrieved memory was healed; the mean per-run share of harmful replays (n = runs checked) and the checked runs with at least one harmful replay.
